name: bitmovin-observability-ad-report
description: Teach Claude how to produce a snapshot-style ad operations report for a Bitmovin Analytics license — the impression→start→quartile→completion funnel, advertiser and ad-system rankings, VAST/ad-server error breakdowns, pod-position cohorts, and ad startup-latency anomaly flags (AdOpsReport object) — via the Bitmovin Observability MCP. The agent decides and frames; tested scripts compute the funnel, concentration ranking, and threshold checks.
